title: Practice Lab: Local Dev Contract & K8s NetworkPolicy Debugging

steps.title: Create Local Dev Makefile Entrypoint
steps.instruction: Create a Makefile with targets for `dev` (runs `docker compose up -d`), `dev-down` (`docker compose down`), and `dev-logs` (`docker compose logs -f`).
steps.hint: Use docker compose -f Backend/local/docker-compose.yml up -d in your Makefile target.

steps.title: Setup Gitignored Secret Template
steps.instruction: Copy secrets.template.yaml to secrets.yaml inside Backend/local/secrets/ and add Backend/local/secrets/secrets.yaml to .gitignore.

steps.title: Debug NetworkPolicy Label Mismatch
steps.instruction: Pods are stuck at Init:1/2 because NetworkPolicy uses 'name: encryption' instead of 'kubernetes.io/metadata.name: encryption'. Fix the label selector.
steps.hint: Inspect the namespace metadata label using kubectl get ns encryption --show-labels.
